blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Backtest auditing is a calibration problem: high flaw recall is not useful when the model falsely flags matched clean strategies. We build a 96-item paired benchmark in which every flawed backtest has a clean control that holds strategy, dates, code style, labels, and reporting scaffold fixed while changing one methodology detail. A deterministic scorer separates flaw recall, clean-control false positives, evidence localization, and fix relevance. Over 1440 cached audits from four text endpoints, the primary DeepSeek auditor reaches 100.0% closed and clean-aware code recall, but open prompts over-flag 93.8% of clean code controls, and clean-aware all-three specificity is 87.5% even where recall saturates. A clean-aware warning drops DeepSeek code false positives from 20.8% (95% CI 11.7–34.3) to 0.0% (0.0–7.4) at unchanged recall, while the budget anchor still flags 38/48 clean controls under the same prompt. Reporting recall alone would rank three of these four models identically; reporting the clean-control rate separates them by 79 points.
blocks.zh: 反测试审计是一个校准问题:当模型错误地标注与干净的战略相匹配时,高缺陷召回是无用的. 我们构建一个96个项目对齐的基准,每个有缺陷的后台测试都有一个干净的控制,它持有策略,日期,代码样式,标签和报告脚手架,同时修改一个方法的细节. 确定计分器将缺陷召回,清洁控制假阳性,证据本地化,定型相关性区分开来. 超过1440次缓存审计, 来自4个文本端点, 主要的DeepSeek审计员 达到 100.0% 关闭和清洁意识代码召回, 清真警告将DeepSeek代码的假阳性值从20.8%(95% CI 11.7–34.3)降至0.0 %(0.0–7.4),而预算锚点仍然标出38/48的清真控制。 仅报告召回即可将这四个模式中的三个模式同级;报告清洁控制率则将它们分开79点。

blocks.en: 1 Calibration as Much as Flaw-Finding
blocks.zh: 1 校准与寻找法拉法一样多

blocks.en: Backtest review is a calibration problem as much as a flaw-finding problem. A useful LLM auditor must detect look-ahead, survivorship, leakage, p-hacking, and execution errors while also letting a clean strategy pass; closed-set recall alone is misleading because false positives add review threads and can obscure the one backtest that actually needs repair.
blocks.zh: 后试审查既是缺陷调查问题,也是校准问题. 一个有用的 LLM 审计员必须检测外观、生存、渗漏、p-hack以及执行错误,同时让干净的策略通过;闭塞的召回本身具有误导性,因为假阳性会增加审查线条,并可能掩盖一个实际需要修复的反向测试。

blocks.en: We therefore make calibration the object of study with a controlled paired benchmark. Each flawed item has a matched clean control that keeps strategy, dates, code style, labels, and reporting scaffold fixed while changing one methodology detail, which separates flaw recognition from a high suspicion prior (Figure 1 ). The benchmark does not certify trading systems; it isolates one review skill.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们用一个有控制的对准基准来校准研究对象。 每个有缺陷的项目都有匹配的清洁控制,保持策略,日期,代码样式,标签,和报告脚手架固定,同时改变一个方法细节,将缺陷识别与之前的高度怀疑区分开来(图1). 该基准不认证交易制度;它孤立了一种审查技能。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Paired clean-control design. Left: legitimate split, lag, and cost lines in a clean control. Right: the same strategy with a planted look-ahead edit. The same open code audit correctly flags the flawed edit but falsely accuses the matched clean control; without a matched control, the false accusation would look like a plausible audit insight.
blocks.zh: 图 1:Paired清洁控制设计. 左:合法分割,滞后,成本线在干净的控制. 右: 相同的策略, 并安装一个外观前端编辑 。 同样的开放式代码审计正确地标出了有缺陷的编辑,但错误地指责了相应的清洁控制;如果没有相应的控制,虚假指控将看起来像一个可信的审计见解。

blocks.en: Prior quantitative-finance work owns backtest overfitting, data snooping, and survivorship bias ( White, 2000 ; Harvey et al., 2016 ; Bailey et al., 2017 ; Lopez de Prado, 2018 ) . Prior LLM-finance and LLM-review benchmarks own backtest generation, look-ahead mitigation, issue-level critique, and LLM-assisted review ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Chaudhuri et al., 2026 ; Ho et al., 2026 ; Zurawicki et al., 2026 ) . This work differs by jointly evaluating matched clean controls, prose and code surfaces, canonical flaw labels, and deterministic evidence and fix scoring.
blocks.zh: 先前的量化金融工作拥有反比测试过度调整,数据窥探,以及幸存者偏见(White,2000;Harvey等人,2016;Bailey等人,2017;Lopez de Prado,2018). 以往的LLM-财务和LLM-审查基准拥有反测试生成、前瞻减缓、问题层面批评和LLM协助审查(Wang等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年;Chaudhuri等人,2026年;Ho等人,2026年;Zurawicki等人,2026年)。 这项工作因联合评估匹配的清洁控制、传言和代码表面、犬科缺陷标签、确定证据和固定评分而不同。

blocks.en: 2 Benchmark and Validator
blocks.zh: 2 基准和验证员

blocks.en: The 96-item set has 48 clean/flawed pairs (48 flawed, 48 clean controls), 6 flawed examples per flaw class, three difficulty strata, and two surfaces per item (prose and code) over | 𝒦 | = 8 |\mathcal{K}|=8 canonical flaws: look-ahead, survivorship, data snooping, full-sample and overlapping-label leakage, unrealistic fills/costs, regime overfit, and p-hacked stop/rule variants, plus a clean label. Clean controls are not merely the absence of an edit. They contain the protective constructs a careful quantitative researcher would write—purged and embargoed splits, explicit one-way costs, half-spread slippage, non-overlapping labels—so a model that pattern-matches on the presence of those constructs will misfire in both directions.
blocks.zh: 96项集有48个干净/伪造的对(48个缺陷,48个干净控制),每个缺陷类有6个缺陷的例子,3个困难层,每件物品有2个表面(prose and code),超过XQK = 8 QQMathcal{K}|=8 犬科缺陷:外观-ahead,幸存,数据透视,全面抽样和重叠标签泄漏,不切实际的填充/成本,制度超合,以及phacked stop/rule变体,加上一个干净的标签. 清洁控制不仅仅是没有编辑。 它们包含了保护性结构,一个仔细的定量研究者会写出—— 净化和禁运的分裂,明确的单向成本,半散的滑坡,非重叠的标签—— 这样一种模式,如果与这些结构的存在相匹配,就会在两个方向上失火。

blocks.en: The prompt grid crosses {open, closed, clean-aware} with {prose, code}. Open omits the taxonomy, closed includes it, and clean-aware adds that clean controls are common. The primary auditor is DeepSeek V4 Flash at temperature 0; the code-slice ladder adds gpt-4o-mini (budget anchor), gemini-2.5-flash-lite , and gpt-4.1-mini . All 1440 item-condition calls parse after a token-cap rerun, at a parse rate of 100.0%.

blocks.en: 3 Results: Recall Is Easy, Calibration Is Not
blocks.zh: 3个 结果: 回忆很简单,校准不是

blocks.en: Table 1: Primary DeepSeek prompt-by-surface confusion matrix. Flawed cells are true positives/false negatives; clean cells are false positives/true negatives. Threads are expected unnecessary reviews per 100 clean submissions.
blocks.zh: 表1:初级深层快速混凝土矩阵。 扁平细胞为真阳性/假阴性;清洁细胞为假阳性/真阴性. 预计每100份清洁呈文将进行不必要的审查。

blocks.en: Table 1 is the primary prompt-by-surface confusion matrix. Open code audits detect 35/48 flawed items but create 45 unnecessary review threads per 48 clean controls, i.e. 93.8 per 100 clean submissions. Closed and clean-aware prompts both reach 100.0% code recall, but only the clean-aware prompt also removes DeepSeek clean false positives on this paired set, dropping code FPR from 20.8% to 0.0% and prose FPR from 2.1% to 0.0% while preserving 100.0% recall.
blocks.zh: 表1是主要的逐层混淆矩阵。 开放代码审核检测出35/48的缺陷项目,但每48个清洁控制中创建45条不必要的审查线索,即每100个清洁提交中创建93.8条. 闭合和清洁感知的提示同时达到100.0%的代码召回,但只有清洁感知的提示同时消除了DeepSeek在这个对齐的集合上干净的假阳性,将代码FPR从20.8%降至0.0%,将FPR从2.1%降至0.0%,同时保留100.0%召回.

blocks.en: The clean-control drop is larger than sampling noise. On code the closed prompt flags 10/48 clean controls, a rate of 20.8% with a 95% Wilson interval of 11.7–34.3%; the clean-aware prompt flags 0/48, an interval of 0.0–7.4%. Those intervals do not overlap. The corresponding recall does not move: both prompts sit at 48/48.
blocks.zh: 清洁控制滴比采样噪音大. 在密码上,闭合即时旗 10/48 清洁控制, 率为 20.8%, 95%的威尔逊间隔为 11.7–34.3%; 清洁即时旗 0/48, 间隔为 0.0–7.4%. 这些间隔并不重叠。 相应的召回不动:两条提示都坐落在48/48.

blocks.en: Clean-aware code all-three specificity is only 87.5% (95% CI 75.3–94.1), decomposing into 100.0% evidence localization and 87.5% fix relevance. The model points at the right lines in every flagged item and still proposes an off-class remedy in six of them. Prose is the easier surface here, at 100.0% all-three specificity under the same prompt. A single audit score would hide the fact that the residual failure sits entirely in the fix column.
blocks.zh: 清洁感知码全三种特异性只有87.5%(95% CI 75.3–94.1),分解成100.0%的证据本地化和87.5%固定相关性. 模型在每个标有标记的项目中指向正确的线条,并且仍然建议在其中6个项目中采取非等级补救. Prose是这里比较容易的表面,在同一个快件下为100.0%的所有三种特异性. 单一的审计分数会掩盖一个事实,即剩余失败完全存在于固定栏中。

blocks.en: The rule baseline is a sanity anchor only, at 25.0% code recall and 100.0% code clean FPR, since clean controls contain protective phrases such as purges and realistic slippage. False positives are not parser noise. Most name an incorrect flaw class and point at a legitimate safeguard: one flags unrealistic_fills_costs while citing a line that sets a 10 bp one-way cost with half-spread slippage, and another flags overlapping_label_leakage while citing non-overlapping labels combined with a purged walk-forward split at a 21-day embargo. Self-reported confidence does not rescue the ranking either. Among the 281 audits in the top confidence bin (above 0.85, mean 0.939), 35.0% of the clean-control judgments are still false positives.
blocks.zh: 规则基线仅是一个疗养锚,在25.0%的代码召回和100.0%的代码清洁FPR中,因为清洁控制包含有清洗和现实滑坡等保护性短语. 假阳性不是解析噪音。 多数人称错误的瑕疵类, 并指向合法保障: 一面旗帜不切实际的_ fills_costs, 同时引用一条线, 用半散的滑坡设置 10 bp 单向成本, 另一面旗帜重叠_ label_leakage, 同时引用不重叠的标签, 加上21天禁运时被清除的走向分裂。 自报信心亦不能挽救排名. 在最高信任箱的281项审计(高于0.85,即0.939)中,35.0%的清洁控制判决仍然是虚假的肯定。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Clean-control false-positive rate by model and prompt mode on the code surface. The vertical spread at the clean-aware prompt is the quantity that recall-only reporting discards: every model in that column is at or near ceiling recall.
blocks.zh: 图2:按模型和代码表面的即时模式分列的清洁控制假阳性率. 在清洁意识时的垂直分布是只报告丢弃物的数量:该列中的每个模型都处于或接近上限召回.

blocks.en: The open-prompt deficit is concentrated rather than spread. On code, the primary auditor recovers 6/6 look-ahead, survivorship, and data-snooping items but only 1/6 full-sample preprocessing and 2/6 regime overfit; on prose the same two classes fall to 0/6 and 4/6. Difficulty strata do not explain it, since open code recall is 12/16 obvious, 11/16 moderate, and 12/16 subtle. Without the taxonomy the model finds the flaws that have familiar names and misses the ones that live inside a preprocessing step. Appendix A gives the full per-class breakdown.
blocks.zh: 开放即期赤字是集中而不是分散的。 在代码上,主要审计师收回了6/6的外观、存活率和数据扫描项目,但只有1/6的全样本预处理和2/6的制度超合;在播音员身上,同样的两个班级降为0/6和4/6. 难以解释,因为公开代码召回明显是12/16、11/16和12/16。 没有分类 模型发现的缺陷 有熟悉的名字 和错过那些 生活在预处理步骤。 附 录 A给出了每个阶级的全部细分.

blocks.en: The false-positive column converts directly into review load, which is why we report C c = 100 ​ F c C_{c}=100F_{c} alongside F c F_{c} . A team that runs the open code prompt over a submission queue of 100 clean strategies opens 93.8 unnecessary threads. The same team running the clean-aware prompt with the primary auditor opens none, and running it with the budget anchor opens 79.2. Recall is identical for the second and third of these, so the entire difference in operating cost is invisible to a recall-only report.
blocks.zh: 假阳性列直接转换成审查负载,这就是为什么我们报告C c = 100 F c + + + + = 100 F + + + = c = 与F c FQQC}(英语:Flickr)并列. 一个在100个干净策略的提交队列上运行打开代码的团队打开了93.8个不必要的线程. 与主要审计师一起运行的清洁意识提示的团队没有开启,而与预算主播一起运行的团队则开启了79.2. 其中第二和第三项的召回完全相同,因此,只召回的报告看不到业务费用的全部差异。

blocks.en: The asymmetry also runs the other way. Under the open prompt the primary auditor misses 13 of 48 flawed code items while raising 45 unsupported flags, so the flagged pile contains more clean strategies than rigged ones. An auditor in that regime is worse than uninformative for triage, because the reviewer who works the queue in order spends most of the budget confirming that legitimate code is legitimate.
blocks.zh: 非对称性也以相反的方式运行. 在开放的提示下,主要审计师错过了48个有缺陷的代码项目中的13个,同时举起45个无支持的旗帜,因此标有标记的堆中包含比操纵的更干净的战略. 该制度中的审计员比分门别类的无信息更糟糕,因为按顺序排队的审查员花费大部分预算,确认合法代码是合法的。

blocks.en: Table 3: Reviewer persona on the clean-aware code condition, primary model, 48 flawed and 48 clean items each. Only the assigned role changes.
blocks.zh: 表3:清洁意识码条件中的审查者人物a,主型号,每型48个缺陷和48个清洁物品. 只有指定的角色改变.

blocks.en: Holding the model, the prompt mode, and the surface fixed, we vary only the reviewer role the system prompt assigns. Table 3 reports the four roles on the clean-aware code condition. Recall is flat at 100.0% for three of them and 95.8% for the fourth, while the clean-control rate moves from 0/48 to 6/48. The two roles that carry an adversarial connotation, risk_manager and skeptical_reviewer , account for 11 of the 12 false positives across the four roles, and risk_manager is also the only role that misses a flawed item.
blocks.zh: 持有模型,即时模式,和表面固定,我们只改变系统即时指定的审查者角色. 表3按清洁意识编码条件报告四个角色。 其中3个和4个是100.0%,95.8%,而清洁控制率从0/48升至6/48。 这四个角色的12个假阳性因素中, 占了11个, 而风险管理是唯一漏掉一个有缺陷的项目的角色。

blocks.en: Mean self-reported confidence tracks the false-positive rate in the wrong direction: the roles that flag more clean controls report lower confidence (0.911 and 0.928 against 0.953 and 0.952), so a confidence filter would discard the flags of the better-calibrated roles first.
blocks.zh: 平均自报信心跟踪错误方向的假阳性率:旗下更干净的控制角色报告信心较低(0.911和0.928相对0.953和0.952),因此信心过滤器会首先丢弃更好校准角色的旗帜.

blocks.en: Prose and code are not interchangeable inputs. Under the open prompt, prose recall exceeds code recall (81.2% against 72.9%) while prose false positives are less than half the code rate (37.5% against 93.8%). Under the closed prompt the recall gap closes to zero and the false-positive gap persists (2.1% against 20.8%). A natural-language description of a methodology therefore elicits a better-calibrated audit than the code that implements it, at least at these sample sizes, and the gap survives being told what to look for.
blocks.zh: Prose和代码不能互换输入. 在公开的提示下,传言召回超过代码召回(81.2%对72.9%),而传言的假阳性低于代码率的一半(37.5%对93.8%). 在封闭的速率下,召回差距接近于零,虚假阳性差距继续存在(2.1%对20.8%)。 因此,对某一方法的自然语言描述,会比执行该方法的代码,至少是这些样本大小,引起更精确的审计,而且差距仍然在人们被告知要寻找什么。

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Under deterministic paired edits, prompt and model choice separate high flaw recall from clean-control calibration; this does not show that an LLM can validate a trading system in production. The takeaway for benchmark design is narrow and practical: backtest-auditor benchmarks should report flaw recall, clean false positives, evidence, fix, and confidence separately, because a single aggregate would have rated all four endpoints in Table 2 as near-solved.
blocks.zh: 在定型配对编辑下,即时和模型选择将高缺陷的召回从清洁控制校准中分离出来;这并不表明LLM能够验证生产中的交易系统. 基准设计的外包范围狭窄且实用:反测试-审计基准应分别报告缺陷召回、清除假阳性、证据、固定和信心,因为一个汇总将表2中的所有四个终点都评为接近解决。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The sample is small, at 6 flawed examples per class, so per-class rates move in steps of 16.7 points and the Wilson intervals in Table 2 are correspondingly wide. Many clean-aware results saturate at 100% recall, which we treat as a finding rather than a solved task, since GPT-4o mini over-flags clean code controls despite perfect recall. The strict lexical scorer may under-credit unusual fixes; alias-only matches account for 56 of the correct responses, or 4.6%, so the scorer’s synonym table is a live sensitivity. Items are synthetic paired edits over a fixed set of strategy skeletons, not externally collected backtest notebooks, and every audit is a single temperature-0 call rather than a multi-turn review. A human baseline packet of 16 items was prepared but not completed, so no human reference rate is reported. A next validator should add semantic entailment for the fix column and externally sourced notebooks for the item pool.
blocks.zh: 样本很小,每类有6个有缺陷的例子,所以每类的费率以16.7分的步数移动,表2中的威尔逊间隔也相应宽. 许多清真结果都以100%的回想起来饱和, 我们把它当作一个发现而不是一个解决的任务, 因为GPT-4o 迷你超标的清真代码控制, 严格的词典记分器可能信用不足异常的修补;别名只匹配占正确响应的56个,即4.6%,因此记分器的同义词表是活的灵敏度. 物品是在一套固定的战略骨架上合成成对编辑的,而不是外部收集的回试笔记本,每次审计都是一次温度-0调用,而不是一次多回合审查. 编制了一份由16件物品组成的人类基线包,但尚未完成,因此没有报告人的参考率。 下一个验证员应增加固定柱的语义涵义和项目池外部来源的笔记本。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: All backtests in the benchmark are synthetic, and no market data, broker record, or proprietary strategy is redistributed. The benchmark measures whether a model recognizes planted methodology flaws under matched controls. It does not certify any trading system, and a high score here is not evidence that a model can validate a real strategy or that any strategy is sound. We report clean-control false positives alongside recall because an auditing tool that over-flags imposes review cost and can crowd out the one submission that genuinely needs repair. The paper makes no claim about profitability and offers no investment advice.
blocks.zh: 基准中的所有回溯测试都是合成的,没有重新分配市场数据,经纪人记录或专有策略. 基准衡量一个模型是否承认在相应控制下人为的方法缺陷。 它不证明任何交易系统,这里的高分并不能证明一个模型能够验证一个真正的策略或者任何策略都是合理的. 我们报告清洁控制假阳性,同时回顾,因为超标的审计工具会强加审查费用,并会排挤真正需要修复的呈件。 该文件没有对盈利能力提出任何主张,也不提供投资建议。

blocks.zh: 附录A 不分类别召回

The closed prompt recovers every class on both surfaces; the open prompt does not, and the shortfall concentrates in full-sample preprocessing and regime overfit.
blocks.zh: 表4列出主要审计员在两面每个缺陷类的开放式即时召回情况,并附有封闭即时召回情况栏供参考。 闭合的即时恢复了两面的每个等级;开放的即时不恢复,不足集中在全样的预处理和制度超合上.

blocks.en: Appendix B Recall Against False Positives by Surface
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: Figure 3 plots the primary auditor’s recall against its clean-control false-positive rate for each prompt mode and surface. The three prompt modes trace a path that moves up and to the left rather than along a single frontier: the clean-aware prompt gains recall over the open prompt and loses false positives at the same time, so the two are not being traded against each other.
blocks.zh: 图3列出主要审计师对每个快速方式和表面的清洁控制假阳性率的召回。 三种即时模式追踪一条向上和向左移动的路径,而不是沿着单一的边疆:清净的即时收益在开放的即时回想起,同时丢失了假阳性,所以两者并没有互相交易.
